subtests.name: getParameters should return RTCRtpEncodingParameters with all required fields
addTransceiver(video) with undefined sendEncodings should have default encoding parameter with active set to true and scaleResolutionDownBy set to 1
addTransceiver(video) with empty list sendEncodings should have default encoding parameter with active set to true and scaleResolutionDownBy set to 1
addTransceiver with a ridiculous number of encodings should truncate the list
addTransceiver(audio) should remove valid scaleResolutionDownBy
addTransceiver(audio) should remove invalid scaleResolutionDownBy
addTransceiver with duplicate rid and multiple encodings throws TypeError
addTransceiver with missing rid and multiple encodings throws TypeError
addTransceiver with empty rid throws TypeError
addTransceiver with invalid rid characters throws TypeError
addTransceiver with scaleResolutionDownBy < 1 throws RangeError
sender.setParameters() with reordered encodings should reject with InvalidModificationError
sender.setParameters() with encodings unset should reject with TypeError
setParameters() with modified encoding.rid field should reject with InvalidModificationError
setParameters() with encoding.scaleResolutionDownBy field set to less than 1.0 should reject with RangeError
setParameters() with missing encoding.scaleResolutionDownBy field should succeed, and set the value back to 1
setParameters() with encoding.scaleResolutionDownBy field set to greater than 1.0 should succeed
setParameters() with encoding.active false->true should succeed (video) with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active false->true should succeed (video) without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active true->false should succeed (video) with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active true->false should succeed (video) without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with modified encoding.maxBitrate should succeed (video) with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with modified encoding.maxBitrate should succeed (video) without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active false->true should succeed (audio) with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active false->true should succeed (audio) without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active true->false should succeed (audio) with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with encoding.active true->false should succeed (audio) without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with modified encoding.maxBitrate should succeed (audio) with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with modified encoding.maxBitrate should succeed (audio) without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with modified encoding.scaleResolutionDownBy should succeed with RTCRtpTransceiverInit
setParameters() with modified encoding.scaleResolutionDownBy should succeed without RTCRtpTransceiverInit
